question: God created the heavens and the earth in six days and rested on the seventh day. True or False?
fact: By the seventh day God had finished the work He had been doing; so on the seventh day He rested.

question: The Bible explicitly states that Adam and Eve ate an apple in the Garden of Eden. True or False?
fact: The Bible calls it the 'fruit of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil'; it never specifies an apple.

question: Noah built the ark out of gopher wood according to God's instructions. True or False?
fact: God told Noah to make himself an ark of gopher wood with rooms and coat it with pitch.

question: The Great Flood rain lasted for only 10 days and nights. True or False?
fact: Rain fell on the earth for forty days and forty nights.

question: Abraham's wife was originally named Sarai before God renamed her Sarah. True or False?
fact: God blessed Sarah and promised that she would be the mother of nations.

question: Esau sold his birthright to Joseph for a bowl of stew. True or False?
fact: Esau sold his birthright to his younger twin brother, Jacob.

question: Jacob had twelve sons, from whom the twelve tribes of Israel descended. True or False?
fact: Jacob's twelve sons became the twelve tribes of Israel.

question: Moses was rescued from a basket in the Nile River by Pharaoh's daughter. True or False?
fact: She named him Moses, saying, 'I drew him out of the water.'

question: God spoke to Moses from a burning bush that was not consumed by the flames. True or False?
fact: Moses saw that though the bush was on fire it did not burn up.

question: God sent a total of 5 plagues upon the land of Egypt. True or False?
fact: God sent 10 plagues upon Egypt before Pharaoh let the Israelites go.

question: The Israelites crossed the Red Sea on dry ground. True or False?
fact: The water was a wall to them on their right and on their left.

question: God provided manna from heaven to feed the Israelites in the wilderness. True or False?
fact: The Israelites ate manna for forty years until they reached the border of Canaan.

question: God gave the Ten Commandments to Aaron on Mount Sinai. True or False?
fact: God gave the Ten Commandments to Moses on Mount Sinai; Aaron was his brother.

question: Moses stayed on Mount Sinai for 40 days and 40 nights. True or False?
fact: Moses entered the cloud as he went on the mountain and stayed forty days and forty nights.

question: After Moses died, Joshua led the Israelites across the Jordan into the Promised Land. True or False?
fact: God commanded Joshua to be strong and courageous as he led His people.

question: The walls of Jericho fell after the Israelites marched around the city for 10 days. True or False?
fact: They marched around the city for 7 days, and 7 times on the seventh day before the walls fell.

question: When Joshua prayed, the sun stood still over Gibeon. True or False?
fact: The sun stopped in the middle of the sky and delayed going down about a full day.

question: Gideon defeated the Midianite army with only 300 men. True or False?
fact: God chose only 300 men who lapped water like a dog so Israel would know the victory was from God.

question: Samson's great physical strength came from his magical sword. True or False?
fact: Samson was a Nazirite dedicated to God; his strength was linked to his uncut hair and vow to God.

question: Ruth was a Moabite woman who chose to follow Naomi to Bethlehem. True or False?
fact: Ruth famously declared, 'Your people will be my people and your God my God.'

question: Ruth married Boaz and became the great-grandmother of King David. True or False?
fact: Ruth and Boaz were the parents of Obed, who was the father of Jesse, the father of David.

question: God called young Samuel three times in the night while he was sleeping in the tabernacle. True or False?
fact: Eli realized the Lord was calling the boy and told Samuel to say, 'Speak, Lord, for your servant is listening.'

question: David was anointed as the very first king of Israel. True or False?
fact: Saul was the first king of Israel; David was anointed as the second king.

question: David defeated the Philistine giant Goliath using a sling and a stone. True or False?
fact: David slung a stone that struck Goliath on the forehead, and he fell to the ground.

question: Jonathan, King Saul's son, was a loyal and close friend to David. True or False?
fact: Jonathan became one in spirit with David, and he loved him as himself.

question: King Solomon asked God for great riches and the death of his enemies. True or False?
fact: Solomon asked for a discerning heart and wisdom to govern God's people.

question: Solomon built the first magnificent Temple for the Lord in Jerusalem. True or False?
fact: Solomon fulfilled the dream of his father David by building the Holy Temple.

question: The Queen of Sheba visited Jerusalem to test Solomon's wisdom with hard questions. True or False?
fact: She was overwhelmed by his wisdom and the glory of his kingdom.

question: During a famine, ravens brought bread and meat to Elijah every morning and evening. True or False?
fact: God commanded the ravens to feed Elijah by the Kerith Ravine.

question: On Mount Carmel, God sent water from heaven to consume Elijah's sacrifice. True or False?
fact: God sent fire from heaven that burned up the sacrifice, the wood, the stones, and licked up the water.

question: Elijah was taken up to heaven in a whirlwind by a chariot of fire. True or False?
fact: A chariot of fire and horses of fire appeared and Elijah went up to heaven in a whirlwind.

question: Naaman the Syrian commander was healed of leprosy after washing 7 times in the Jordan River. True or False?
fact: His flesh was restored and became clean like that of a young boy.

question: Daniel was severely injured by the lions when he was thrown into the lions' den. True or False?
fact: God sent His angel to shut the mouths of the lions; no wound was found on Daniel.

question: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego were unharmed when thrown into the blazing furnace. True or False?
fact: The fire had not harmed their bodies, nor was a hair of their heads singed.

question: Jonah spent 3 days and 3 nights inside the belly of a great fish. True or False?
fact: The Lord provided a huge fish to swallow Jonah after he was thrown into the sea.

question: 'The Lord is my shepherd, I lack nothing' is the opening line of Psalm 23. True or False?
fact: Psalm 23 is David's most beloved song of trust in God's pastoral care.

question: Psalm 119 is the shortest chapter in the entire Bible. True or False?
fact: Psalm 117 is the shortest chapter (2 verses); Psalm 119 is the longest chapter.

question: 'God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble' is found in Psalm 46:1. True or False?
fact: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth give way and the mountains fall into the sea.

question: 'The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge' is a central theme in Proverbs. True or False?
fact: True wisdom begins with reverence and awe for Almighty God.

question: 'Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding' is Proverbs 3:5. True or False?
fact: In all your ways submit to Him, and He will make your paths straight.

question: The book of Ecclesiastes was written by the prophet Moses. True or False?
fact: Ecclesiastes was written by the Teacher, son of David, king in Jerusalem (Solomon).

question: 'He was pierced for our transgressions, He was crushed for our iniquities' is Isaiah 53:5. True or False?
fact: This famous prophecy describes the suffering Messiah centuries before Christ's birth.

question: Jesus was born in the town of Nazareth in Galilee. True or False?
fact: Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea; He grew up in Nazareth.

question: The angel Gabriel announced to Mary that she would give birth to the Savior. True or False?
fact: Gabriel told Mary that the Holy Spirit would come upon her and she would bear the Son of God.

question: The Wise Men from the East presented gifts of gold, frankincense, and myrrh to Jesus. True or False?
fact: They bowed down and worshiped the child, opening their treasures to honor Him.

question: Shepherds in the fields were the first to hear the angel's announcement of Christ's birth. True or False?
fact: 'Today in the town of David a Savior has been born to you; He is the Messiah, the Lord.'

question: King Herod traveled to Bethlehem to sincerely worship baby Jesus. True or False?
fact: Herod sought to kill Jesus and ordered the slaughter of all baby boys in Bethlehem under two years old.

question: Joseph took Mary and baby Jesus to Egypt to escape King Herod. True or False?
fact: An angel warned Joseph in a dream, and they stayed in Egypt until Herod died.

question: At age 12, Jesus was found in the Temple sitting among the religious teachers. True or False?
fact: Everyone who heard Him was amazed at His understanding and His answers.

question: Jesus was baptized by John the Baptist in the Jordan River. True or False?
fact: Jesus told John it was proper for us to do this to fulfill all righteousness.

question: When Jesus was baptized, the Holy Spirit descended on Him like a dove. True or False?
fact: A voice from heaven said, 'This is my Son, whom I love; with Him I am well pleased.'

question: Jesus fasted for 40 days and 40 nights in the wilderness before being tempted by Satan. True or False?
fact: Jesus was led by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.

question: 'Man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word from the mouth of God' was Jesus' response to Satan. True or False?
fact: Jesus defeated every temptation of the devil by quoting Scripture.

question: Peter and Andrew were the first two disciples called by Jesus. True or False?
fact: 'Come, follow me,' Jesus said, 'and I will send you out to fish for people.'

question: Matthew was sitting at a tax collector's booth when Jesus called him to be a disciple. True or False?
fact: Jesus said, 'Follow me,' and Matthew got up and followed Him.

question: Luke the physician was one of the original 12 apostles chosen by Jesus. True or False?
fact: Luke wrote the Gospel of Luke and Acts, but he was not one of the original 12 apostles.

question: Jesus' very first miracle was turning water into wine at a wedding in Cana. True or False?
fact: What Jesus did here in Cana of Galilee was the first of the signs through which He revealed His glory.

question: Jesus fed 5,000 men with five loaves of bread and two fish. True or False?
fact: They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up 12 basketfuls of broken pieces.

question: Peter walked on water toward Jesus until he saw the wind and became afraid. True or False?
fact: When Peter cried out, 'Lord, save me!', Jesus immediately reached out His hand and caught him.

question: Jesus calmed a raging storm on the Sea of Galilee by commanding, 'Quiet! Be still!' True or False?
fact: The wind died down and it was completely calm, leaving His disciples in awe.

question: A woman who had suffered from bleeding for 12 years was healed when she touched the edge of Jesus' cloak. True or False?
fact: 'Daughter, your faith has healed you. Go in peace,' Jesus told her.

question: When Jesus healed 10 men with leprosy, all 10 returned to thank Him and praise God. True or False?
fact: Only one of the ten lepers—and he was a Samaritan—came back to thank Jesus.

question: At the pool of Bethesda, Jesus healed an invalid who had been sick for 38 years. True or False?
fact: Jesus said to him, 'Get up! Pick up your mat and walk,' and at once the man was cured.

question: Jesus raised Lazarus from the dead after Lazarus had been in the tomb for 4 days. True or False?
fact: Jesus called in a loud voice, 'Lazarus, come out!' and the dead man came out.

question: Jesus raised the 12-year-old daughter of Jairus, a synagogue leader, from the dead. True or False?
fact: He took her by the hand and said, 'Talitha koum!' which means, 'Little girl, I say to you, get up!'

question: In Nain, Jesus touched a funeral coffin and raised a widow's only son back to life. True or False?
fact: 'Young man, I say to you, get up!' and the dead man sat up and began to talk.

question: Jesus healed a man born blind by putting mud on his eyes and telling him to wash in the Pool of Siloam. True or False?
fact: So the man went and washed, and came home seeing.

question: Blind Bartimaeus shouted, 'Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!' near Jericho and was healed. True or False?
fact: Jesus said, 'Go, your faith has healed you,' and immediately he received his sight.

question: Jesus traveled to a Roman centurion's house and touched his servant to heal him. True or False?
fact: The centurion said, 'Just say the word, and my servant will be healed,' and Jesus healed him from a distance.

question: Four men lowered a paralyzed man through an open roof so Jesus could heal him. True or False?
fact: Seeing their faith, Jesus forgave the man's sins and told him to take up his mat and walk.

question: In the Parable of the Prodigal Son, the younger son squandered his inheritance and ended up feeding pigs. True or False?
fact: He longed to fill his stomach with the pods that the pigs were eating, but no one gave him anything.

question: In the Parable of the Good Samaritan, both a priest and a Levite stopped to help the wounded traveler. True or False?
fact: The priest and Levite passed by on the other side; only the Samaritan took pity and helped him.

question: In the Parable of the Sower, seed that fell on good soil produced a crop 30, 60, or 100 times what was sown. True or False?
fact: The good soil represents those who hear God's word, understand it, and bear fruit.

question: In the Parable of the Ten Virgins, five were wise and five were foolish. True or False?
fact: The wise virgins took extra oil in jars along with their lamps.

question: In the Parable of the Talents, the servant given one talent invested it and doubled his master's money. True or False?
fact: The servant given one talent was afraid and hid his master's money in the ground.

question: In the Parable of the Lost Sheep, the shepherd left the 99 sheep to search for the 1 that was lost. True or False?
fact: When he found it, he joyfully put it on his shoulders and went home to celebrate.

question: In the story of the Rich Man and Lazarus, angels carried poor Lazarus to Abraham's side after he died. True or False?
fact: Lazarus was comforted at Abraham's side in eternal peace.

question: At the Last Supper, Jesus washed His disciples' feet to teach them humble servanthood. True or False?
fact: 'Now that I, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also should wash one another's feet.'

question: Judas Iscariot betrayed Jesus to the chief priests for 30 pieces of silver. True or False?
fact: The chief priests counted out for him thirty pieces of silver.

question: While praying in the Garden of Gethsemane, Jesus' sweat was like drops of blood falling to the ground. True or False?
fact: Being in anguish, He prayed more earnestly, and His sweat was like drops of blood.

question: Peter, James, and John stayed awake all night praying with Jesus in Gethsemane. True or False?
fact: They fell asleep from sorrow and exhaustion; Jesus asked, 'Couldn't you keep watch with me for one hour?'

question: Judas identified Jesus to the arresting crowd by greeting Him with a kiss. True or False?
fact: Judas approached Jesus to kiss Him, saying, 'Greetings, Rabbi!'

question: Peter denied knowing Jesus three times before the rooster crowed. True or False?
fact: Immediately a rooster crowed, and Peter remembered Jesus' word and wept bitterly.

question: Pontius Pilate found no guilt in Jesus and washed his hands before the crowd. True or False?
fact: 'I am innocent of this man's blood,' Pilate said as he washed his hands before the multitude.

question: Jesus was crucified at a place called Golgotha, which means 'The Place of the Skull.' True or False?
fact: Golgotha is the Aramaic name for the skull-shaped hill outside Jerusalem.

question: Simon of Cyrene was forced by Roman soldiers to carry Jesus' cross. True or False?
fact: As they were going out, they met a man from Cyrene named Simon, and they forced him to carry the cross.

question: Roman soldiers placed a crown of solid gold on Jesus' head to mock Him. True or False?
fact: They twisted together a crown of thorns and set it on His head.

question: Jesus promised the repentant thief on the cross, 'Today you will be with me in Paradise.' True or False?
fact: Even in His dying moments, Jesus offered mercy and salvation to the penitent criminal.

question: Jesus' last words on the cross before He died were 'It is finished.' True or False?
fact: When He had received the drink, Jesus said, 'It is finished,' and He bowed His head and gave up His spirit.

question: When Jesus died, the curtain of the Temple was torn in two from top to bottom. True or False?
fact: The earth shook, the rocks split, and direct access to God was opened through Christ.

question: Joseph of Arimathea asked Pilate for Jesus' body and placed Him in his own new tomb. True or False?
fact: Joseph wrapped the body in clean linen and placed it in his new tomb cut out of rock.

question: Jesus rose from the dead early on Sunday morning, the third day after His crucifixion. True or False?
fact: 'He is not here; He has risen, just as He said!' the angel told the women at the tomb.

question: Mary Magdalene was the first person to see the risen Jesus near the empty tomb. True or False?
fact: When Jesus called her name, 'Mary,' she recognized Him and cried out, 'Rabboni!'

question: Thomas initially doubted Jesus' resurrection until he saw the nail marks in His hands. True or False?
fact: 'Unless I see the nail marks in His hands... I will not believe,' Thomas said.

question: Upon seeing the risen Christ, Thomas proclaimed, 'My Lord and my God!' True or False?
fact: Jesus told him, 'Because you have seen me, you have believed; blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed.'

question: Jesus walked and talked with two disciples on the road to Emmaus without them recognizing Him at first. True or False?
fact: Their eyes were opened when Jesus broke bread with them at their table.

question: Jesus remained on earth for 100 days after His resurrection before ascending to heaven. True or False?
fact: Jesus appeared to His disciples over a period of 40 days and spoke about the kingdom of God.

question: 'Go into all the world and preach the gospel to all creation' is known as the Great Commission. True or False?
fact: Jesus commanded His followers to make disciples of all nations.

question: Jesus ascended into heaven from the Mount of Olives while His disciples watched. True or False?
fact: A cloud hid Him from their sight as two angels promised His future return.

question: On the Day of Pentecost, the Holy Spirit descended like tongues of fire on the believers in the upper room. True or False?
fact: All of them were filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other tongues.

question: About 3,000 people were saved and baptized after Peter's sermon on the Day of Pentecost. True or False?
fact: Those who accepted his message were baptized, adding about three thousand to their number that day.

question: Peter and John healed a lame beggar at the Temple gate called Beautiful. True or False?
fact: 'Silver or gold I do not have, but what I do have I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, walk.'

question: Ananias and Sapphira died immediately after lying to the Holy Spirit about the price of their land. True or False?
fact: Peter told Ananias, 'You have not lied just to human beings but to God.'

question: Peter was the very first Christian martyr stoned to death for his faith. True or False?
fact: Stephen was the first Christian martyr; he prayed for his enemies as he was stoned to death.

question: Philip explained the prophet Isaiah to an Ethiopian eunuch on a desert road and baptized him. True or False?
fact: The Ethiopian went on his way rejoicing after being baptized in water.

question: Saul (Paul) was surrounded by a blinding light from heaven while traveling on the road to Damascus. True or False?
fact: He heard the voice of Jesus saying, 'Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?'

question: God sent Ananias to lay hands on Saul in Damascus so he could regain his sight and be filled with the Holy Spirit. True or False?
fact: Something like scales fell from Saul's eyes, and he could see again.

question: Peter prayed and raised a godly woman named Tabitha (Dorcas) from the dead in Joppa. True or False?
fact: Peter got down on his knees and prayed, saying, 'Tabitha, get up,' and she opened her eyes.

question: Cornelius, a Roman centurion, was the first Gentile householder to receive the Holy Spirit. True or False?
fact: While Peter was speaking, the Holy Spirit came on all who heard the message.

question: The disciples were called 'Christians' for the very first time in Jerusalem. True or False?
fact: The disciples were called Christians first at Antioch.

question: An angel rescued Peter from prison the night before Herod intended to bring him to trial. True or False?
fact: The chains fell off Peter's wrists and the angel led him past the guards into the city.

question: While Paul and Silas were singing hymns in a Philippian prison at midnight, an earthquake shook the jail open. True or False?
fact: All the prison doors flew open and everybody's chains came loose.

question: 'For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son' is found in John 3:16. True or False?
fact: Whoever believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.

question: 'The wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord' is Romans 6:23. True or False?
fact: God's free gift of eternal life is available to all who turn to Christ.

question: 'In all things God works for the good of those who love Him' is written in Romans 8:28. True or False?
fact: This promise encourages believers that God sovereignly guides every detail of their lives.

question: 1 Corinthians 13 is famously known throughout the world as the 'Love Chapter.' True or False?
fact: 'Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast...'

question: Galatians 5:22 lists only 5 fruit of the Holy Spirit. True or False?
fact: There are 9 fruit of the Spirit: love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control.

question: 'For it is by grace you have been saved, through faith—and this is not from yourselves, it is the gift of God.' True or False?
fact: Salvation is a gift of God, not by works, so that no one can boast.

question: Paul instructs believers to put on the 'full armor of God' to stand against the devil's schemes. True or False?
fact: The armor includes the belt of truth, breastplate of righteousness, shield of faith, and helmet of salvation.

question: 'I can do all this through Him who gives me strength' is Philippians 4:13. True or False?
fact: Christ provides the inner strength to endure any circumstance in life.

question: 'Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice!' was written by Paul while in prison. True or False?
fact: Philippians is often called the 'Epistle of Joy' because of Paul's joyful attitude in captivity.

question: 'Pray continually, give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God's will for you in Christ Jesus.' True or False?
fact: Constant prayer and gratitude are foundational to a thriving Christian life.

question: 'All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for teaching, rebuking, correcting and training in righteousness.' True or False?
fact: God inspired the Scriptures so that the servant of God may be thoroughly equipped for every good work.

question: 'Now faith is confidence in what we hope for and assurance about what we do not see' is Hebrews 11:1. True or False?
fact: Hebrews 11 is celebrated as the 'Hall of Faith' honoring Old Testament heroes of faith.

question: It is possible to please God without faith as long as you do good works. True or False?
fact: Without faith it is impossible to please God, because anyone who comes to Him must believe that He exists.

question: 'Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever' is found in Hebrews 13:8. True or False?
fact: Our Savior's nature, love, and truth never change across time.

question: 'Faith without deeds is dead' is a key teaching in the Epistle of James. True or False?
fact: As the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without deeds is dead.

question: 'Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.' True or False?
fact: 'Come near to God and He will come near to you,' James exhorts believers.

question: 'You are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, God's special possession' is 1 Peter 2:9. True or False?
fact: God chose us to declare the praises of Him who called us out of darkness into His wonderful light.

question: The devil prowls around like a roaring lion looking for someone to devour. True or False?
fact: Peter urges believers to be alert and of sober mind against the enemy.

question: 'If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just and will forgive us our sins' is 1 John 1:9. True or False?
fact: The blood of Jesus purifies us from all unrighteousness.

question: 'God is love... There is no fear in love. But perfect love drives out fear.' True or False?
fact: Whoever lives in love lives in God, and God in them.

question: The Bible states that wealth and earthly power are what overcome the world. True or False?
fact: This is the victory that has overcome the world, even our faith.

question: The Book of Revelation was written by the apostle Peter on the island of Patmos. True or False?
fact: The Book of Revelation was written by the apostle John while exiled on the island of Patmos.

question: 'I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End' is declared by Jesus. True or False?
fact: Christ proclaims His eternal sovereignty over all time and creation.

question: 'Here I am! I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in.' True or False?
fact: Jesus offers intimate fellowship to any person or church who opens their heart to Him.

question: The New Jerusalem in heaven needs the sun and the moon to shine on it. True or False?
fact: The city does not need the sun or moon to shine on it, for the glory of God gives it light, and the Lamb is its lamp.

question: God will wipe every tear from their eyes, and there will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain. True or False?
fact: The old order of things will pass away forever in God's eternal kingdom.

question: The Tree of Life bears twelve kinds of fruit, yielding its fruit every month. True or False?
fact: And the leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations.

question: The very last verse of the Bible is 'The grace of the Lord Jesus be with God's people. Amen.' True or False?
fact: The entire Bible concludes with this beautiful benediction of grace.
